here's a winner clone bred by brooks Garcia and grown out by Rob Co. This plant photographed below suffered a lot since it was growing in low light levels almost all summer long, but now that Rob has it in a brighter greenhouse, the colors are starting to come back! I definitely want one-the lid gets solid white, and with the red throat contrast, and the shape is really nice! This plant is quite vigorous, and Rob is working diligently to produce divisions to get out there.

The name is in honor of Adrian Slack and Leah Wilkerson-2 legacies in the carnivorous plant world that will live past our time:

posts.body_html:
some new photos, taken in late April/early May. A proven winner even when grown outdoors, which in my mind, makes it a solid cultivar. This is one of the most outstanding plants I've ever seen:














One last photo, and yes, these pics definitely do this clone justice!

Just to make sure I didn't open a can of worms: Rob is still working on this clone, and has intentions to register it and get it out into circulation. Please give him AT LEAST a good 2-3 years of time to produce clones, as this plant is still very brand new to cultivation. I am merely a custodian of this plant for the time being, and he still has the rights to it. Oh yeah, and while I'm on the subject of disclaimers, parental guidance is suggested
